in_sanskrit.name: Ghanasyaam
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है He who protects
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ghanasyaam एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Ghanasyaam is a Sanskrit name derived from the root 'Ghan' meaning 'protector'. This name is bestowed upon a child born to a protective father or to one who embodies the qualities of protection and strength.
